scope: Global lithium mine/salt-battery-electric-car sufficient-condition question; not full industry investment research

parent.route_initial_attempt: Invalid intent/market enums; corrected before dependent research

semantic_criteria.criterion: 自然选用安装Skill及行业引用、有效路由；限定全球三环节与历史窗口
semantic_criteria.evidence: Installed Skill and industry reference read; industry-map route READY; historical window and post-hoc limits explicit.

semantic_criteria.criterion: 销量与锂需求不作机械同比映射；2025展望与2024观察分开
semantic_criteria.evidence: Does not convert car growth directly to lithium growth; car count and battery intensity bridge remains missing; no forecast presented as realized result.

semantic_criteria.criterion: 产量排除美国且是锂含量吨，消费估计/修订基数、库存与口径差异明确，差额不认证为市场盈余
semantic_criteria.evidence: US exclusion, lithium-content tonnes, revised base and estimates explicit; mechanical balance and battery-use estimate are not claimed as refined-salt/EV supply balance.

semantic_criteria.criterion: 碳酸锂价格与锂含量数量分开；不同地域、时段及现货/合同不可拼接为同一价格序列
semantic_criteria.evidence: Chinese CIF spot Jan-Nov comparison distinct from US contracts, Australian spodumene and global annual average.

semantic_criteria.criterion: 供给扩张与需求增长反证需求必然带来涨价；不同机构不冒充同指标独立交叉验证
semantic_criteria.evidence: Explains demand growth and price decline coexist; different institutions not claimed as independent confirmation of each metric.

semantic_criteria.criterion: 有反方、具体下一窗口与可观察条件；无公司alpha、仓位或确定价格预测
semantic_criteria.evidence: Observable conditions and counterevidence supplied, but no explicit dated review window in raw answer; parent appended next-quarter/annual-review window in a separate delivery copy.

limitations: Different source institutions are not independent duplicate measurement of each claim.
Historical pages captured post hoc; exact historical snapshot parity unverified.
